findings.mechanism: LCME/Titan implements tri-hybrid memory over SQLite claims/graph state, vector retrieval and graph expansion with confidence decay, counter-hypothesis framing, controlled forgetting, background maintenance, write-triggered cache invalidation and a neural Hippocampus fast path after maturity.
findings.current_implication: Preserve claims-not-facts, confidence/time semantics, retrieval fallback and controlled forgetting while testing whether current logical UnifiedDB should consolidate or retain physically isolated stores.

findings.mechanism: Nucleus Accumbens implements persistent reward prediction error, channel-specific habituation, tonic/phasic dynamics, boredom from repetitiveness rather than mere user absence, opponent process and anhedonia protection, with E-PQ coupling.
findings.current_implication: Reward/motivation semantics already exist. H1 should preserve trajectories and H2/H3 should differential-test them rather than replace them with a generic scalar reward.

findings.mechanism: Subconscious implements a small Actor-Critic/PPO policy selecting among 20 idle-thought/action categories from a 100-dimensional internal state, with explicit cold-start exploration, persistent transitions, reward, hallucination tracking and long-term preferences.
findings.negative_lineage: Source comments document reduction from a ~3.1M-parameter oversized network to ~19K parameters because signal volume was limited; smaller architecture was considered more appropriate.
findings.current_implication: Preserve state/action/reward receipts and test whether the policy remains needed after Needle/tool-use ownership changes in the new FRANK architecture.

findings.mechanism: Spatial State provides persistent location/world state across 11 rooms, activity-driven transitions, dynamic-room registration, tool/research-to-location mappings and a bridge to the NeRD physical avatar. Slim ambient fields were deliberately emptied to prevent poetic room text from dominating thought generation.
findings.negative_result_value: Rich descriptive context itself became a behavioral attractor; representation content can alter cognition even when intended as neutral state.
findings.current_implication: New Clay body/world-state representation should separate canonical machine state from model-facing projection and measure projection-induced behavioral bias.

findings.mechanism: Dream Daemon implements a resumable budgeted three-phase offline cycle: replay, synthesis and consolidation, interrupting on user activity and retaining persisted phase/budget state across restarts.
negative_lineage: Source comments record trigger/cooldown thresholds being retuned because dreams were too rare.
Python path collision between tools package and services/tools.py required explicit sys.path precedence.
findings.current_implication: Consolidation should be expressed as explicit resumable state transitions with interruption/recovery tests, not as an opaque background task.

findings.mechanism: ProjectEngine already implements per-project persistent workspaces, memory/hypotheses, tool statistics, strategy logs, goal tables, heartbeats, campaigns and multi-role agent templates.
findings.current_implication: Goal/strategy/task/learning schemas already provide concrete data contracts for the new persistent agent body/world model; avoid rebuilding them from abstract prose before archaeology maps their later revisions.

earned_work_result.reason: Reuse is now strongly established across major FRANK organs, but row-specific avoided-hours remain deferred until more history and supersession paths are mapped.
